# Zest Mavericks

> A two person studio in Bangalore, India, building absurdly intuitive apps for iPhone: MarkPDF, a PDF editor and scanner, and TopDrawer, a private vault for everything you save.

Contact: zestmavericks@gmail.com. Website: https://zestmavericks.com/

## MarkPDF

MarkPDF (Mark PDF on the App Store) is a PDF editor and scanner for iPhone. Scan documents, sign, merge, split and lock PDFs, delete pages, and summarise long PDFs with AI.

- Listed on the App Store as “Mark PDF: PDF Editor & Scanner”.
- Status: Available on the App Store. Requires iOS 16.0 or later.
- Prices (US): Weekly $7.99/week, Monthly $12.99/month, Yearly $39.99/year.
- Languages: English, Arabic, French, Hindi, Japanese, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish.
- [MarkPDF page](https://zestmavericks.com/markpdf/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6737065841)

## TopDrawer

TopDrawer is a private vault for iPhone. Save text, links, screenshots, PDFs and files from anywhere, and find any of them with one search, including the words inside your screenshots. Nothing leaves the device.

- Status: Coming soon to iPhone. Requires iOS 26 or later.
- Prices (US): Monthly $4.99/month, Yearly $24.99/year, Lifetime $59.99/once.
- Languages: English.
- [TopDrawer page](https://zestmavericks.com/topdrawer/)

## MarkPDF guides

- [How to delete pages from a PDF on iPhone](https://zestmavericks.com/markpdf/how-to/delete-pages-from-a-pdf-on-iphone/): In MarkPDF, tap Delete Pages, choose the PDF, then tap each page you want to remove so it's ticked, and tap Delete. Tap Preview first to check the document without those pages.
- [How to password-protect a PDF on iPhone](https://zestmavericks.com/markpdf/how-to/password-protect-a-pdf-on-iphone/): Open MarkPDF, tap Lock PDF, choose the document, type a password and tap Lock PDF. The PDF then asks for that password before it opens, and Remove Lock takes the password off again.
- [How to scan documents to PDF on iPhone](https://zestmavericks.com/markpdf/how-to/scan-documents-to-pdf-on-iphone/): Open MarkPDF, tap Scan Document, then Scan Documents, and hold your iPhone over the page. MarkPDF finds the edges of the page and captures it; scan every page, tap Save, and they're saved together as a PDF.
- [How to summarise a PDF with AI on iPhone](https://zestmavericks.com/markpdf/how-to/summarise-a-pdf-with-ai-on-iphone/): Open MarkPDF, tap Summarise PDF, then Choose a File and pick the document. MarkPDF gives you a short summary, so you can see what a long PDF covers before you read all of it.

## TopDrawer guides

- [How to lock saved passwords and notes with Face ID on iPhone](https://zestmavericks.com/topdrawer/how-to/lock-passwords-and-notes-with-face-id-on-iphone/): Save them in TopDrawer and turn on its lock: Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode is then needed before TopDrawer opens. TopDrawer offers the lock the first time you save something that looks like a password, and it falls back to your passcode, so you can't lock yourself out.
- [How to search for text inside screenshots on iPhone](https://zestmavericks.com/topdrawer/how-to/search-text-inside-screenshots-on-iphone/): Save the screenshot to TopDrawer, then type any word you remember from it into Search everything. TopDrawer reads the text in every screenshot on your iPhone, so the one with that word comes up, even if you never gave it a name.
